dslRule:
<!id: combo.getCaretPosition>
<!description: Adopt new org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Combo.getCaretPosition() API.
Replaces accessing the 'y' coordinate of 'getSelection()' with the direct 'getCaretPosition()' method, which was introduced for this purpose.>
<!severity: INFO>

$combo.getSelection().y :: instanceof($combo, "org.eclipse.swt.widgets.Combo")
=>
$combo.getCaretPosition()
;;
